info.name: Skyhigh Networks External APIs Tenant API

items.docs:
For _**authenticated tenant**_, retrieves a list of incident group IDs with corresponding incident group (incidentType.category.name).
  ```
  URL example --
  https://www.myshn.net/shnapi/rest/external/api/v1/queryIncidentGroups
  ```

For _**authenticated tenant**_, retrieves a list of keys to access values from the Incident.information map.
  ```
  URL example --
  https://www.myshn.net/shnapi/rest/external/api/v1/queryIncidentInformationKeys
  ```

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of items that will be returned within a single response. If value exceeds maximum '10000' it will not be flagged as an error but will also not increase results.
